recipes.name: Easy Parmesan-Crusted Chicken
ingredients_raw: 4 (5 ounce) boneless, skinless chicken breast halves

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix mayonnaise and Parmesan together in a medium bowl until well combined.
Arrange chicken on the prepared baking sheet. Spread mayonnaise mixture over top, then top with bread crumbs.

Cook in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Parmesan-Crusted Chicken
raw_recipe.description: Try this Parmesan-crusted chicken recipe for juicy, tender chicken breasts coated in a mixture of Parmesan cheese and seasoned bread crumbs.

review.reviewBody: Once you try this you will never just bread chicken again. Truly moist on the inside and light crunch to the coating.I rubbed mixture all over then fully coated in bread crumbs.

Very tasty. Instead of topping the chicken with the mayonnaise mixture, I smeared it all over the chcken and then dropped the pieces into a baggie with the crumb mixture and shook to coat. Doing it this way was somewhat messy, but the result was yummy.

As written the recipe is pretty good. I didn't need all the mayo to coat the chicken. The breading can get a little soggy. Second time around I made some adjustments. Instead of combining everything, I thinly coated the chicken with mayo and then dredged it in the bread crumb mixture. For the mixture, I added a few seasonings to my taste, like pepper and garlic powder. When cooking, I put the breasts on a baking rack to keep from getting soggy. Made it 5 stars

This was easy to make, tasty and quick too! I will make this again. I didn't have a problem with it being too dry or too greasy. We put it on top of spaghetti and marinara for an easy chicken parm meal.
Love this recipe. I add fresh garlic to the mayo and let it sit in the fridge for a couple of hours before I spread it on the chicken - really amps up the flavor.
Substituted plain Greek yogurt for mayo because of an egg allergy, it was good. I rubbed mix all over chicken and coated in bread crumbs. Will make again.

This was a super easy recipe and turned out delicious. My husband said I should add this meal to our regular rotation. I did jeuje it up a bit by adding about 1/2 tsp of garlic powder, 1 tsp of Italian seasoning, 1/2 tsp pepper, and 1/2 tsp of sweet paprika to the mayo/cheese mixture before spreading it over the chicken. I also sprinkled about 1/2 Tbsp of panko Italian seasoned bread crumbs over the top to make the chicken extra crispy. Finally, to help with making sure the chicken is cooked all the way through, I had two large chicken breasts that I cut in half and then I pounded out my chicken until it was about 1/2" thick, which ensured that it gets done in the 20 minutes allotted. They turned out perfect, and it's a quick recipe to prepare!

This is good, but I used half the mayo and added an egg with fresh grated Parmesan, Romano, and Asiago cheeses, pepper, garlic powder, and roasted some Panko bread crumbs first. Came out crispy, juicy and delicious!

I’ve been making this for years and it is Delicious !!!!! I use Pecorino Romano cheese - a bit sharper than regular Parmesan. As a matter of fact - I made it tonight . Make sure you use parchment paper. This sticks to non-stick aluminum foil.
Made it in the air fryer. So moist and tasty. Easy to prepare and every bite is satisfying and yummy.

This was good but not great. It does have potential. I cut the chicken breasts in half horizontally and reduced the amount of mayonnaise. To the mayonnaise, I added a bit of onion powder, garlic powder, and dried oregano and also used panko and spritzed the top with EVOO from my mister. Baked on a baking rack so the air would circulate underneath and not get soggy. I coated both sides of the chicken breast and turned it about half way through cooking time. I reduced the cooking time due to the thinness of the breast. I turned the chicken again and turned the oven from bake to broil for a couple minutes to crisp it up more. Sliced on the diagonal and served with spaghetti with homemade marinara sauce. I will make again but next time I think I will use even less mayonnaise and sear it quickly on both sides in the cast iron skillet before putting in the oven in the cast iron skillet.
I wanted an easy recipe for chicken and my daughter suggested chicken parm. I automatically came to all recipes. This was perfect. Easy and quick and delicious!

These chicken breasts were flavorful and delicious. I've been making them for years, serving them with either buttered noodles or rice. However, I think we like them best served with pasta and marinara sauce on the side.
Keeper for sure!
The first time I made this I accidentally coated both sides. It still turned out great. My family absolutely loves this chicken. Being from the south, however, I use Dukes mayonnaise.
Easy and yummy, added some extra seasoning to the breasts before coating, gave them a broiler finishing touch. thanks!

I made it just as it said, and added some spices to it. I added garlic powder, and garlic and herb mix. It was very delicious 😋 and I will definitely be making it again! Thank you for sharing this wonderful recipe.

We loved this recipe. Made it as is, other than cutting my chicken breasts in half due to their size, and was a crowd pleaser! It was so simple but so worth it! We will be adding this to the weekly menu.
My husband and I loved this recipe! It makes enough for 2 meals, too. We like it with garlic angel hair pasta and a green salad.
Delicious! How does such a simple recipe taste so good? Don't skip the bread crumbs; they add an extra texture that gives this dish more depth.
